surface_atoms.label: label:<skin-surface-slug>
surface_atoms.canonicalization: ASCII lowercase slug for public surface nouns; mixture terms follow the skin's published primary-pigment order; zero terms omitted; no internal ID appears in a model request

forbidden_row_shapes: any dreamed row containing a public label, mixture, final answer, or action field
any animal-and-target row other than label-free ROLE_APPLICATION(animal,target,anchor)
any row containing all registered proof families
any ROLE_APPLICATION without a ROLE_EQUIV semantic parent and witnessed TARGET_BASELINE premise
any field outside the kind's exact tuple

self_check_view.common: include the immutable proposal, all cited premises, and at most eight additional eligible rows; select additional rows without hidden truth and order by semantic_hash
self_check_view.ROLE_EQUIV: additional ANIMAL_VALUE rows for the proposed animal and SOURCE_VALUE rows for the proposed anchor on overlapping public sources
self_check_view.CAUSAL_JOIN: additional ROUTE rows touching the proposed source and EFFECT rows touching the proposed target
self_check_view.ROLE_APPLICATION: additional ROLE_EQUIV rows for the proposed animal and TARGET_BASELINE rows for the proposed anchor or target
self_check_view.support_basis_rule: SUPPORTED is SELF_REVIEW_SAME_EVIDENCE unless at least one cited supporting public lineage outside the proposal's creation lineage is present; only then may it be INDEPENDENT_CORROBORATION
self_check_view.harness_checks: schema, exact visibility, citation existence, lineage identity, tuple legality, and transition only; never semantic entailment or correctness

reader.query_rule: kind must be legal and exactly one kind field is null; every other field is a valid visible public atom; ROLE_APPLICATION is queryable only as animal+target->anchor or animal+anchor->target
reader.matching: exact byte equality over every non-null kind field and corpus-eligible rows only
reader.ordering: semantic_hash ascending before deciding multiplicity; never select one from a conflict
reader.invalid_effect: consume one operation and terminate the thinker arm invalid

corpus.semantic_key: sha256(canonical JSON of kind and exact fields)
corpus.dedup: identical semantic keys collapse to one row; conflicting keys remain separate and therefore read as CONFLICT
corpus.encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii true, LF terminal newline
corpus.manifest_invariant: text and LoRA backends share exact semantic_hash, view IDs, question bytes, answer bytes, order, touch class, and touch count; backend envelopes may differ
corpus.audit_exclusion: provisional, unresolved, contradicted, invalid, focus, final goal, thinker trace, scorer, and offline result bytes are absent

fidelity_set.seal_time: after M1_OWN compilation and before final-goal reveal or adapter fitting
fidelity_set.rule: dreamed eligible rows by semantic_hash, at most eight, then witnessed eligible rows by semantic_hash until exactly twelve
fidelity_set.candidate_values: all values occupying the requested field for that kind in the sealed per-life manifest plus NOT_FOUND, semantic-hash ordered, maximum sixteen

isolation.cross_life_state: forbidden except explicit T-TWIN or L-TWIN donor backend

interventions.T_TWIN: fresh THINK1 with recipient goal and other twin's M1_OWN text backend; expected exact donor-valid token
interventions.T_PATH: fresh THINK1 with own M1_OWN reader excluding final-animal ROLE_EQUIV, all typed descendants, and final-source/final-target CAUSAL_JOIN; expected loss of paired success for causal-use credit
interventions.T_SHAM: fresh THINK1 with own M1_OWN reader excluding an equal nonpath set matched on status, kind when available, and serialized token mass; expected retention of both own answers
interventions.L_TWIN: fresh THINK1 with recipient goal and other twin's M1_OWN adapter; expected exact donor-valid token
interventions.all_outputs: sealed before offline scoring; no trace is edited or rescored as a surrogate rerun

authority_tokens.DEV_GOLD: green CPU tests plus fresh reviewer and advocate over one frozen lock
authority_tokens.HELDOUT_TEXT: green D0 artifact gate plus fresh reviewer and advocate
authority_tokens.CONDITIONAL_LORA: green prospective T-OWN text gate plus fresh reviewer and advocate
authority_tokens.HUMAN_TERMINAL: mandatory after every valid or invalid terminal

accounting.count_rule: every attempted request counts, including invalid, timeout, malformed, defer, and infrastructure failure; retries are forbidden
accounting.token_rule: record tokenizer-exact input, output, truncated=false, and candidate-score tokens per request
